usage: workflow [-h]
                {init,sync,status,doctor,roots,hermes,open,list,close,save} ...

positional arguments:
  {init,sync,status,doctor,roots,hermes,open,list,close,save}
    init                Initialize the v2 scaffold
    sync                Generate checksum-locked tool shims from AGENTS.md
    status              Show a human-readable repo summary
    doctor              Validate the v2 scaffold
    roots               Inspect workspace roots from repo-owned config
    hermes              Run Hermes inventory, preflight, analysis, preview,
                        and the explicit no-content connectivity gate
    open                Resolve or create a project across configured roots
    list                List projects across configured roots
    close               Show close-out guidance for the current repo
    save                Append a session marker for the current repo

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
